dungeons.name: Hall of Thanes
dungeons.description: Someone has broken into the royal dwarven burial chamber beneath Ironforge.

quests.name: An Ancient Grudge
quests.pickup: Ghostly Attendant, inside Hall of Thanes, after the first room
quests.objective: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest.

quests.name: Important Heirlooms
quests.pickup: Thom Filch, by the bridge / vault entrance in Ironforge
quests.objective: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
quests.turnin: Thom Filch, near the dungeon entrance

quests.name: The Restless Dead
quests.pickup: Afadra Dunwall, Ironforge
quests.objective: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions and 10 Tormented Souls, then put Anvilmar's spirit to rest.

quests.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
quests.pickup: Earthseer Farsen, Dun Morogh (after Underground Map)
quests.objective: Enter Hall of Thanes and claim Durgen Dirgehammer's Head.
quests.note: The chain begins by dropping Dark Iron Map from Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.

startItem.name: Dark Iron Map
startItem.from: Dropped by: Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh

quests.name: The Treaty of Understanding
quests.pickup: Stone tablet inside a vault in the Reliquary of Kings (Durgen Dirgehammer's room)
quests.objective: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
quests.note: The tablet is inside one of the vaults in the Reliquary of Kings, in Durgen Dirgehammer's final boss room. Open the vaults and interact with the tablet before leaving the dungeon.

dungeons.name: Ragefire Chasm
dungeons.description: Troggs and Burning Blade cultists infest the molten caverns beneath Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
quests.pickup: Rahauro, Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff
quests.objective: Kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shamans inside Ragefire Chasm.

quests.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
quests.pickup: Rahauro, Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff
quests.objective: Find Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside Ragefire Chasm and search it for anything of interest.
quests.turnin: Maur Grimtotem's corpse, inside Ragefire Chasm
quests.note: Step 1 of 2. Completing this at Maur's corpse starts Returning the Lost Satchel.

quests.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
quests.pickup: Grimtotem Satchel, from Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside Ragefire Chasm
quests.objective: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
quests.note: Step 2 of 2. Starts from the Grimtotem Satchel inside the dungeon.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.pickup: Thrall, Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar
quests.objective: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker inside Ragefire Chasm.
quests.note: Requires the earlier Hidden Enemies chain steps in Orgrimmar. The next Hidden Enemies step later offers:

quests.name: Slaying the Beast
quests.pickup: Neeru Fireblade, Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar
quests.objective: Slay Taragaman the Hungerer and recover Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart.
quests.turnin: Neeru Fireblade, Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar

quests.name: The Power to Destroy...
quests.pickup: Varimathras, Royal Quarter, Undercity
quests.objective: Collect Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether inside Ragefire Chasm.

dungeons.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
dungeons.description: Scourge forces still haunt the ruined capital while a necromancer gathers power within the city.

quests.name: Abominable Creatures
quests.pickup: Captain Truman, just inside Ruins of Lordaeron (left of the entrance)
quests.objective: Collect the Head of the Baron in Ruins of Lordaeron.
quests.turnin: Captain Truman, just inside Ruins of Lordaeron

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.pickup: Item start: Abominable Head, inside Ruins of Lordaeron
quests.objective: Deliver the Abominable Head to the Undercity.
quests.note: Step 1 of a 5-part chain. The final chain step lets you choose Monstrous Cleaver, Grave Shroud or Slain Baron's Signet.

quests.name: A Frightened Request
quests.pickup: Tabitha Heartweaver, Silverpine Forest / The Sepulcher
quests.objective: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in Ruins of Lordaeron.
quests.turnin: Tabitha Heartweaver, The Sepulcher, Silverpine Forest

quests.name: Bloodied Insignia
quests.pickup: Item start: Bloodied Insignia, inside Ruins of Lordaeron
quests.objective: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias.

startItem.name: Bloodied Insignia
startItem.from: Dropped by: undead enemies inside Ruins of Lordaeron

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.pickup: Item start: Crest of Lordaeron, inside Ruins of Lordaeron
quests.objective: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Stormwind.
quests.note: Community reports indicate the Crest can spawn at one of several locations inside the dungeon. Reported spots include upper floors of towers, side/crypt rooms near The Baron, and the area around Bjork.

startItem.name: Crest of Lordaeron
startItem.from: Reported random spawn inside Ruins of Lordaeron; check towers, side rooms and the Bjork area

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.pickup: Item start: Crest of Lordaeron, inside Ruins of Lordaeron
quests.objective: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to the Undercity.
quests.note: Community reports indicate the Crest can spawn at one of several locations inside the dungeon. Reported spots include upper floors of towers, side/crypt rooms near The Baron, and the area around Bjork.

startItem.name: Crest of Lordaeron
startItem.from: Reported random spawn inside Ruins of Lordaeron; check towers, side rooms and the Bjork area

quests.name: Light's Justice
quests.pickup: Morbin Lightbane, Undercity
quests.objective: Collect 25 Intact Limbs within Ruins of Lordaeron.

quests.name: Remember That I Love You
quests.pickup: Item start: Blood-Stained Letter, graveyard inside Ruins of Lordaeron
quests.objective: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale.
quests.note: Item-start quest from the Blood-Stained Letter.

startItem.name: Blood-Stained Letter
startItem.from: Found in the graveyard inside Ruins of Lordaeron

quests.name: The New Plague
quests.pickup: Theodore Griffs, Undercity
quests.objective: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang.

quests.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
quests.pickup: Deathguard Kristof, Brill, Tirisfal Glades
quests.objective: Kill Rath'mael in Ruins of Lordaeron.

dungeons.name: The Deadmines
dungeons.description: The Defias Brotherhood is building a warship in the mines beneath Moonbrook.

bosses.name: Miner Johnson
bosses.note: Rare spawn in the side passage after Rhahk'Zor.

quests.name: Red Silk Bandanas
quests.pickup: Scout Riell, Sentinel Hill tower, Westfall
quests.objective: Collect 10 Red Silk Bandanas from Defias inside the Deadmines.
quests.turnin: Scout Riell, Sentinel Hill tower, Westfall
quests.note: Requires the Defias Brotherhood escort step.

quests.name: Collecting Memories
quests.pickup: Wilder Thistlenettle, the Dwarven District, Stormwind
quests.objective: Collect 4 Miners' Union Cards from undead miners in the tunnels outside the instance.
quests.note: The undead side tunnel is before the instance portal.

quests.name: Destruction in Deadmines
quests.pickup: Use the Extra-Destructive Explosives quest-start item.
quests.objective: Place the explosives beside the forge in the Deadmines.
quests.turnin: Alba Fairmoon, hills behind Moonbrook near the Deadmines exit

quests.name: Oh Brother...
quests.pickup: Wilder Thistlenettle, the Dwarven District, Stormwind
quests.objective: Recover Thistlenettle's Badge from Foreman Thistlenettle in the undead side tunnel.
quests.note: The foreman is in the tunnels before the instance portal.

quests.name: Underground Assault
quests.pickup: Shoni the Shilent, the Dwarven District, Stormwind
quests.objective: Recover the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from Sneed's Shredder.
quests.note: Follows Speak with Shoni.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.pickup: Gryan Stoutmantle, Sentinel Hill tower, Westfall (56.4, 47.5)
quests.objective: Defeat Edwin VanCleef and collect his head.
quests.note: Final dungeon step of the Defias Brotherhood chain; complete the earlier steps first.

quests.name: The Unsent Letter
quests.pickup: Use An Unsent Letter, looted from Edwin VanCleef.
quests.objective: Take the letter to the city architect in Stormwind.
quests.turnin: Baros Alexston, City Hall, Cathedral Square, Stormwind
quests.note: Starts a follow-up chain that continues with Bazil Thredd.

dungeons.name: Wailing Caverns
dungeons.description: Deep beneath the Barrens, druids and fanglords guard the sleeping Naralex while twisted beasts prowl the caverns.

quests.name: Deviate Hides
quests.pickup: Nalpak, above the entrance to Wailing Caverns, The Barrens
quests.objective: Bring 20 Deviate Hides to Nalpak.
quests.turnin: Nalpak, above the entrance to Wailing Caverns, The Barrens

quests.name: Smart Drinks
quests.pickup: Mebok Mizzyrix, Ratchet, The Barrens
quests.objective: Bring 6 Wailing Essence to Mebok Mizzyrix.
quests.note: Follows Raptor Horns.

quests.name: Trouble at the Docks
quests.pickup: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz, Ratchet, The Barrens
quests.objective: Retrieve the 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish in Wailing Caverns.
quests.turnin: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz, Ratchet, The Barrens

quests.name: Deviate Eradication
quests.pickup: Ebru, above the entrance to Wailing Caverns, The Barrens
quests.objective: Kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
quests.turnin: Ebru, above the entrance to Wailing Caverns, The Barrens

quests.name: The Glowing Shard
quests.pickup: Item start: Glowing Shard, dropped by Mutanus the Devourer
quests.objective: Travel to Ratchet to find someone who can identify the Glowing Shard, then deliver it as directed.
quests.turnin: Follow the quest directions beginning in Ratchet
quests.note: The direct quest has no item reward. Its follow-up, In Nightmares, later offers:

quests.name: Leaders of the Fang
quests.pickup: Nara Wildmane, Thunder Bluff
quests.objective: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane.
quests.note: Requires the Barrens oasis quest chain. Complete The Barrens Oases, The Forgotten Pools, The Stagnant Oasis and Altered Beings, then Hamuul Runetotem and Nara Wildmane before Leaders of the Fang becomes available.

quests.name: Serpentbloom
quests.pickup: Apothecary Zamah, Thunder Bluff
quests.objective: Collect 10 Serpentbloom from Wailing Caverns.

dungeons.name: Shadowfang Keep
dungeons.description: Archmage Arugal and his worgen followers hold the keep above Pyrewood Village.

quests.name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
quests.pickup: High Executor Hadrec, The Sepulcher, Silverpine Forest
quests.objective: Find Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent inside Shadowfang Keep.

quests.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
quests.pickup: Doan Karhan, The Barrens
quests.objective: Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan.
quests.note: Warlock class quest. The fragments come from Shadowfang Keep and Blackfathom Deeps.

quests.name: The Book of Ur
quests.pickup: Keeper Bel'dugur, Apothecarium, Undercity
quests.objective: Bring the Book of Ur from Shadowfang Keep to Keeper Bel'dugur.

quests.name: Arugal Must Die
quests.pickup: Dalar Dawnweaver, The Sepulcher, Silverpine Forest
quests.objective: Kill Archmage Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver.
quests.turnin: Dalar Dawnweaver, The Sepulcher, Silverpine Forest
quests.note: The current Forever quest data also lists Arcane Intellect as a learned reward.

dungeons.name: Blackfathom Deeps
dungeons.description: A flooded night elf ruin on the Zoram Strand, occupied by naga, murlocs and Twilight's Hammer cultists serving Aku'mai.

bosses.name: Baron Aquanis
bosses.note: Optional quest-summoned encounter associated with the Fathom Stone; not part of the current 5-player seven-boss route.

quests.name: Knowledge in the Deeps
quests.pickup: Gerrig Bonegrip, Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge (50.8, 5.6)
quests.objective: Recover the Lorgalis Manuscript from Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.note: The Lorgalis Manuscript is inside a Pitted Iron Chest underwater in the Pool of Ask'ar, in the northern alcove just past Ghamoo-ra's turtle room.

startItem.name: Lorgalis Manuscript
startItem.from: Found in a Pitted Iron Chest underwater in the Pool of Ask'ar, in the northern alcove just past Ghamoo-ra's turtle room.

quests.name: Researching the Corruption
quests.pickup: Gershala Nightwhisper, Auberdine, Darkshore (38.3, 43.1)
quests.objective: Collect 8 Corrupted Brain Stems from creatures in Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.note: Follows The Corruption Abroad.

quests.name: In Search of Thaelrid
quests.pickup: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass, Craftsmen's Terrace, Darnassus
quests.objective: Find Argent Guard Thaelrid inside Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.turnin: Argent Guard Thaelrid, inside Blackfathom Deeps
quests.note: Leads to Blackfathom Villainy. The quest is technically shareable cross-faction in Classic, but its pickup is deep inside Darnassus.

quests.name: Twilight Falls
quests.pickup: Argent Guard Manados, Craftsmen's Terrace, Darnassus (55, 24)
quests.objective: Collect 10 Twilight Pendants from Twilight's Hammer members in Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.turnin: Argent Guard Manados, Craftsmen's Terrace, Darnassus

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
quests.pickup: Argent Guard Thaelrid, inside Blackfathom Deeps
quests.objective: Defeat Twilight Lord Kelris and recover the Head of Kelris.
quests.note: Follows In Search of Thaelrid.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
quests.pickup: Use the Damp Note dropped by Blackfathom Tide Priestesses
quests.objective: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

startItem.name: Damp Note
startItem.from: Drops from Blackfathom Tide Priestess in the entrance tunnels leading to Blackfathom Deeps.

quests.name: Trouble in the Deeps
quests.pickup: Tsunaman, Stonetalon Mountains
quests.objective: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
quests.note: Introductory step leading to The Essence of Aku'Mai.

quests.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
quests.pickup: Je'neu Sancrea, Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale (12, 34)
quests.objective: Collect 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai in Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.note: Follows Trouble in the Deeps.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
quests.pickup: Je'neu Sancrea, Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale (12, 34)
quests.objective: Defeat Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.note: Follows the Damp Note version of Allegiance to the Old Gods.

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
quests.pickup: Argent Guard Thaelrid, inside Blackfathom Deeps
quests.objective: Defeat Twilight Lord Kelris and recover the Head of Kelris.

quests.name: Amongst the Ruins
quests.pickup: Je'neu Sancrea, Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale (12, 34)
quests.objective: Recover the Fathom Core from the Fathom Stone in Blackfathom Deeps.
quests.note: The Fathom Stone is also associated with the optional Baron Aquanis encounter.
